sibling_pairs_kept.index_title: Minimum Pair Removal to Sort Array II

selection_rules.cf: all problems with complete official tests, then a seeded draw from the rest (example-level evidence only)
selection_rules.dev: disjoint queries used only to set lookup thresholds before the evaluation run
selection_rules.lcb: seeded draw of 32 AtCoder stdin and 18 LeetCode functional problems
selection_rules.recognition_absent: LeetCodeDataset test problems not drawn for solving; excluded from the index with their aliases
selection_rules.recognition_known: index entries with validated LeetCodeDataset tests, not in a sibling family
selection_rules.recognition_siblings: families sharing a slug base with roman-numeral suffixes; two members per family, each queried by paraphrase
selection_rules.solving_eligibility: usable import; at least one parseable public example; for LeetCodeDataset the reference passes its public and hidden tests in the sandbox
